reason: It is one bedroom wall that is bubbling, so I will call our painter, he will look at the damp and fix that wall with whatever paint he trusts. I am not handing ₹78,000, almost a month's salary, for the whole house inside and out to a brand and a crew I have never dealt with.
objection: I have not heard much about Turbolux. Is it really as good as the big brands, or will I be repainting again after two monsoons, and who comes back to honour that guarantee?
would_change_my_mind: If our own family painter told me Turbolux is as good as the big brands and he would do the job with it under the same guarantee.
